suite: Breeze WebGL known conformance gaps (not the curated gate)

tests.reason: The upstream helper loads shaders using synchronous XMLHttpRequest, which Breeze does not implement. Native bounds have separate direct tests; the helper is not replaced.
The upstream helper requires unsupported synchronous XMLHttpRequest. Real uint index draws and malformed ranges have separate direct tests.

In a debug build this synchronous multi-shader test exceeds the unchanged two-second document task watchdog. Direct native mip/projection/gradient tests pass; full upstream conformance is not claimed.
